entities.summary: Tarja Turunen (b. 1977-08-17, Puhos) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Puhos and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
